user.title: Add a ping target
user.description: Continuously pings an IPv4 host and reports packet loss and round-trip time statistics.

data_description.host: Host name or IPv4 address to ping.
data_description.name: Optional; defaults to the host.
data_description.payload_size: Bytes of payload per echo request (56 = default `ping`). Above ~1472 B packets get fragmented on a 1500 B MTU path.
data_description.timeout: A reply arriving later than this counts as lost.
data_description.window: Seconds of history the loss and RTT statistics are computed over.
data_description.publish_interval: How often the sensors are updated, in seconds.
data_description.ttl: IP time-to-live of the echo requests.
data_description.down_after: Consecutive lost packets before connectivity turns off.
data_description.up_after: Consecutive replies before connectivity turns back on.

error.cannot_resolve: The host name cannot be resolved to an IPv4 address.
error.socket_not_permitted: Home Assistant is not allowed to open an ICMP socket. Allow unprivileged ping (sysctl net.ipv4.ping_group_range) or grant CAP_NET_RAW.
error.window_too_short: The window must be at least two ping intervals long.
error.window_shorter_than_timeout: The window must be longer than the timeout.
error.publish_longer_than_window: The update interval must not be longer than the window.
